blocks.source: assert rows_on(q, **{'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'p', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 10), (2, 2, 'p', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 5), (3, 2, 'p', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 15) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)"}) == [(3, 2, '15.00')], 'single order is never above itself'

assert rows_on(q, **{'order_items': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(sku AS STRING) AS sku, CAST(qty AS INT) AS qty, CAST(unit_price AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS unit_price FROM VALUES (1, NULL, 1, 1), (1, 'SKU-4001', 1, 1) AS order_items(order_id, sku, qty, unit_price)", 'orders': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id, CAST(status AS STRING) AS status, CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM VALUES (1, 1, 'paid', TIMESTAMP'2026-01-01 00:00:00', 1) AS orders(order_id, customer_id, status, order_ts, amount)", 'products': "SELECT CAST(sku AS STRING) AS sku, CAST(category AS STRING) AS category, CAST(list_price AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS list_price FROM VALUES ('SKU-4001', 'K', 1), ('SKU-4002', 'K', 1) AS products(sku, category, list_price)"}) == [('SKU-4002', 'K')], 'null sku in items'

assert rows_on(q, **{'order_items': "SELECT CAST(order_id AS INT) AS order_id, CAST(sku AS STRING) AS sku, CAST(qty AS INT) AS qty, CAST(unit_price AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS unit_price FROM VALUES (1, 'X', 1, 1), (2, 'X', 1, 1), (3, 'SKU-4001', 1, 1) AS order_items(order_id, sku, qty, unit_price)", 'products': "SELECT CAST(sku AS STRING) AS sku, CAST(category AS STRING) AS category, CAST(list_price AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS list_price FROM VALUES ('SKU-4001', 'K', 1) AS products(sku, category, list_price)"}) == [('X',)], 'duplicates collapse'

assert rows_on(q, **{'employees': "SELECT CAST(emp_id AS INT) AS emp_id, CAST(name AS STRING) AS name, CAST(dept AS STRING) AS dept, CAST(manager_id AS INT) AS manager_id, CAST(salary AS INT) AS salary, CAST(hire_date AS DATE) AS hire_date FROM VALUES (1, 'a', 'X', NULL, 200, DATE'2020-01-01'), (2, 'b', 'X', 1, 200, DATE'2020-01-01'), (3, 'c', 'X', 1, 150, DATE'2020-01-01'), (4, 'd', 'Y', NULL, 90, DATE'2020-01-01'), (5, 'e', 'Y', 4, 90, DATE'2020-01-01') AS employees(emp_id, name, dept, manager_id, salary, hire_date)"}) == [('X', 150), ('Y', None)], 'ties at the top, single-salary dept'
